case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You have little spare capacity and want volume you can plan with. Option A gives you exactly that: a binding annual volume over a long contract term, with your own lead time.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On our past orders:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Option A is the package we can approve. It secures the full volume with you over the long term, at a price that reflects these points.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, in plain words: Option A gives Ravensteiner a binding volume every year for the whole contract term, a lead time you set yourselves, and a customer whose orders you can plan around. We ask you to take Option A to the committee as it stands.

Just before closing: what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We can accommodate your requested volume of 23,400 units, the 36-month contract term, and the 56-day lead time. 

We have noted your cost estimates and quality records; however, our pricing reflects the specialized nature of our production. We meet the agreed quality targets. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal, and our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

Therefore, we offer a revised unit price of EUR 31.70 for this package. Specifically, our Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You have little spare capacity and want volume you can plan with, and your last offer already accommodates the volume, the contract term and the lead time. Option A keeps all three exactly as you set them out and makes the volume binding for the whole term, so you can plan your seal capacity with us for the full period.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 29.30; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you the full volume under a firm commitment across the whole contract term, at the lead time you named. The one point still open is the unit price. We have taken note that you keep your calculation to yourselves, so we are not asking for a breakdown.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Should your pricing committee need to approve it, Option A is a simple case to put before them: a binding annual volume and a long contract term with one customer, with no change to the lead time and the contract length you proposed. I would ask you to take Option A to them in that form.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Please provide the data on which you base your claims regarding our capacity. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In response to your movement, we offer a unit price of EUR 31.40 for the package of 23,400 units, a 36-month contract, and a 56-day lead time.

To summarize our Angebot: a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
